candidates.claim: `Metric.card_maximalSeparatedSet` is stated using `encard`, so the lemma name is misleading: it is not a `Fintype.card`/`Finset.card` statement.
candidates.requested_change: Rename `Metric.card_maximalSeparatedSet` to `Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet` (or `Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet_eq`) and update downstream uses accordingly.
candidates.suggested_fix: Keep the current proof; only change the identifier (and adjust `rw [← …]` occurrences).

candidates.claim: In `Metric.coveringNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber`, the `h_nonempty` branch binder is unused; the proof only needs to split off the `A = ∅` case.
candidates.requested_change: Replace the `rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty A with (h_empty | h_nonempty)` split by `by_cases h_empty : A = ∅` (or use `_ | _` without naming the nonempty witness) to avoid an unused hypothesis.

candidates.claim: `Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset` proves the false branch with a verbose `simp only` list, whereas the analogous `minimalCover_subset` uses a shorter `simp` proof.
candidates.requested_change: Simplify the second branch of `Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset` to `simp [maximalSeparatedSet, h]` (or `simp [maximalSeparatedSet, h]`) instead of the long `simp only`.
candidates.suggested_fix: `· simp [maximalSeparatedSet, h]` closes the goal since it reduces the `dite` to `∅ ⊆ A`.

candidates.claim: `Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet` uses a fairly long manual contradiction argument to show `x ∉ maximalSeparatedSet` and to derive `¬ edist a b < ε` facts, with several `simp` steps on `h_dist` and membership; this can be shortened and made more robust using `have`/`rcases` with `by_cases` plus `simp [C]` to manage the union/insert cases.
candidates.requested_change: Refactor `Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet` to use a structured `by_cases` on membership in `maximalSeparatedSet`/`{x}` and `simp [C]` for set membership, avoiding ad-hoc `simp at h_dist` and repeated manual membership rewrites.
candidates.suggested_fix: One approach: define `C := insert x (maximalSeparatedSet ε A)`; use `simp [C]` for membership; derive `hx_not_mem` via `by simpa [isCover_iff]`-style negation; in the separated proof use `rcases ha with rfl | ha` after `simp [C] at ha` to split cases.
